ai.title: AI Health Assistant
ai.subtitle: Speak or type symptoms in English, Hindi or Marathi and get health guidance
ai.disclaimer: Informational only. This tool does not give a veterinary diagnosis. A qualified veterinarian should confirm any health concern. For severe symptoms, contact a vet immediately.
ai.placeholder: Speak with the microphone button or type here (e.g. Not chewing cud since morning, belly looks swollen)...
ai.listening: Listening... speak clearly into your microphone. You can edit the text below before submitting.
ai.noSpeech: Browser speech recognition is not supported in this browser (try Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge). You can still type or edit your description in the text box below.
ai.micDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Please allow microphone access or type your description below.
ai.emptyText: Select an animal, speak or type symptoms, and press "Check Animal Health".
ai.urgentBanner: Severe signs – contact a veterinarian promptly.

voiceChat.contextCardSub: The assistant checks these recorded facts before answering:
